generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
GST will be paid as per the present rates at 18%, if GST revises (Increases or Decreases) same shall be paid accordingly as per the Govt Circular No: FD 417 EXP-12/2024 Date: 09/08/2024.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.

All necessary arrangements shall be made and precaution taken to prevent completely or partially, damage to the structure or labours / employees during construction period. (As per recent Labour Act) Contractor shall be fully responsible for any damage to the structure during the construction and maintainance period.Any damage caused due to any reasons shall be rectified / replaced at his own cost as per the direction of Engineer in charge. Nothing shall be payable by the Department on account of inclusive of all such arrangements/ precautions work needed.

Tenderer shall obtain the Work Done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer( District Level Officer), scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the tender. The Original Certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bids for physical verification

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards labour welfare fund.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject one or all Tenders without assigning any reasons.

The Item Rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials & other taxes as per the rates prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all leads and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery & equipment etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of work.
The awarded Contractor has to Submit his bills through e-MB for payment.( Billing is through e-Mb ie: Contractor has to produce Soft copy and hard Copy of RA or Final bill for payments)
The Item rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on construction materials
Department will not supply any materials.

The construction materials (minerals metal ,sand and Murom) shall be bought from the authorized quarries along with the mineral dispatch permit or else 5 times the royalty will be deducted as penalty as per the Directions on the Director, Mines and Geology Department Bangalore proceedings dated 25.03.2013.

The Important Original Documents Certificates which are uploaded like Work done Line of Credit Turn over Certificates and Machineries Ownership Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Tender for physical verification. If fail to Produce documents Certificates on or before the time of opening the Bid is liable for Rejection with out any prior notice.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/95/LET/2013 Bangalore dated 01.04.2013 the Contractor shall be registered under section 7 of Buildings and other Construction workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act and the construction labour shall get the registration under section 12 of the act before making payment of running bills
The amount put to tender and tendered amount are exclusive of GST.

The Project Completion period is 06 months and the Tenderer should maintain the Road during the defect liability period, which is upto Two (02) years after successful completion of the work.Followed by (3) Three years maintenance
All materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on work.

It is mandatory to use Manufactured sand as per Govt. Circular No.PWD 72 BMS 2013 Dtd.31-07-2013.Also it is mandatory that the bidders should upload the required documents which demonstrate that the bidder owns sand manufacturing unit or an agreement with the manufactured sand suppliers. The Manufactured sand should be got tested to confirm IS 383-2007 before use.
Work Completion/Execution Period : 06 Months(INCLUDING MONSOON PERIOD)
The field Lab shall preferably located, adjacent to the site with the required amenity as per the clause. Failing which 1% of the amount of work done will be penalized
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty First day of March of succeeding year both days inclusive
Royalty Charges will be Deducted in every bill of contract as per rules
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

All safety precautions warning signs night illumination reflectors deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. The contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-4 KPWD and further orders thereon
Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount 5% of the Contract price
Only relevant document needs to be uploaded. un-necessary documents or any kind of fake documents will lead to rejection of tender.
Any Deviation or error or Mistakes found in units of items they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 continued for 2026-27and the rates shall be quoted accordingly
This bid documents clause No. 34.4 to be implemented as per deligation of power vide GO No. 423 FC-1 2018 Bangalore dated 24.09.2018
Conditional tenders are not accepted
The KPWD code, KTTP Act/Rules, Delegation of Powers, Circular of Contract Management Module and other Government orders issued by Government from time to time will apply.
